source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Commercial facts are source-reviewed against the book pages. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: Club Atlantis
entities.source_summary: High-end multilevel club owned by a major Fixer, with an expensive bar and a clientele mixing corporate climbers and deal-making Fixers.

local_offerings.label: Premium bar serving drinks from around the world

services.label: Social setting for Fixer contacts and deals

entities.catalogue_note: Direct source review supports club hospitality and drinks but does not establish a recurring market or general merchandise shelf. The audit's night-market assortment is therefore not realized.

audit.note: The high-confidence audit inference is narrowed because the reviewed source text describes a club/bar and Fixer meeting environment, not an item market.

entities.name: Kasim’s
entities.source_summary: Coffee shop serving Turkish food, tobacco and cardamom-flavored street coffee; no alcohol is served and the business closes on Fridays.
entities.catalogue_note: The source identifies prepared food, coffee and tobacco rather than generic shelf merchandise. These offerings stay local instead of inheriting the audit's broad entertainment/electronics/fashion departments.

entities.name: Worthy Housing
entities.source_summary: Low-cost cargo-container housing adapted for full-body-conversion residents.

audit.note: Housing is retained as useful world context but not promoted to retail.

entities.name: DRGS 247 (The Glen)
entities.source_summary: A DRGS 247 branch located beside Worthy Housing and specifically noted for carrying glucose-rich brain solution in bulk.
entities.catalogue_note: This location-specific branch is explicitly established by the source, but its highlighted bulk brain solution does not map cleanly to the current catalogue and remains a local offering.

audit.note: Recovered from direct source review as a nearby commercial branch rather than incorrectly attaching its stock to Worthy Housing.
